slice.real_problem: The sole production DeepSeek caller still emits OpenAI ChatCompletions wire data even though the user selected the official Anthropic Messages interface as CodeWhale's release target.
slice.acceptance: One DeepSeekModelPort projects, sends, parses, accounts, retries, reopens, and attributes Anthropic Messages requests for root, read-only child, and explicit Writer without a callable Chat production path.
slice.replaced_path: OpenAI Chat planner, Bearer sender, choices/delta parser, /chat/completions endpoint, and old official base_url values
slice.evidence: offline request/response/SSE fixtures; root/read-only/Writer and CLI/TUI/API conformance; process crash/reopen; locked/offline two-binary artifact; billing-complete limited official canary
slice.cutover_deletion: remove the old Chat production planner/parser/sender endpoint and config acceptance plus every temporary control adapter

official_contract.legacy_alias_retirement: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner retire at 2026-07-24 15:59 UTC
official_contract.stream_usage_semantics: message_start supplies input-side usage; message_delta supplies cumulative output usage; the final normalized usage must be complete before accounting is sealed
official_contract.cache_semantics: Anthropic input_tokens is the uncached remainder; normalized total input is input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens
